paras: Gekko ernstkelleri is a species of gecko, a lizard in the family Gekkonidae. The species is endemic to the Philippines.
The specific name, ernstkelleri, is in honor of Ernst Keller, who is a German supporter of gecko conservation.
G. ernstkelleri is found on the northwest peninsula of the island of Panay in the Philippines.
The total length (including tail) of G. ernstkelleri can exceed 20 cm (7.9 in).

G. ernstkelleri lives in caves and near limestone outcrops in forested areas, as well as in disturbed areas near forests, at altitudes from sea level to 300 m (980 ft). It is locally common within its small range.
